finding: By hand, BR-113 lets dispatch prepare-story write 'the next free wave number' into the ledger, and BR-117 lets dispatch add put a finding 'in a new wave, the next free number'. For BUG-0090 added by hand, add writes wave N, and prepare-story BUG-0090 may write wave N+1. Then wave N holds no unit of work and no wave record, and BR-113 makes prepare-story refuse. State that by hand prepare-story keeps the wave that add wrote, and writes the next free number only for an entry without a wave. Owner: domain-modeling-agent.
why_this_severity: Keeping the wave that add wrote is the plain reading of 'a new wave', so an implementer can act (no to fails_purpose); the writer of RL-03-IT-02 must read BR-113 and BR-117 together to see that the two numbers may differ (raises_cost).
